summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by Magnum Ice Cream Co N.V. reporting a director/PDMR share acquisition. The filing discloses that Chief Creative Officer Julien Barraux purchased 1,000 ordinary shares at EUR 13.70 on May 21, 2026, and 1,200 ordinary shares at EUR 13.78 on May 22, 2026, on the Amsterdam Stock Exchange. The total consideration was EUR 30,236. The filing is a standard notification under EU/UK Market Abuse Regulation, not a special situation. No corporate event, transaction, or structural change is announced. There is no recommendation, advisor, premium, or regulatory clock. What to watch: ordinary insider buying; no risk-arb angle.
